title: Detector-evading clone: calm 'CFO'
persona: Priya, finance executive at Kaveri Textiles
description: A high-quality, calm and polite clone. The voice detector alone would pass it. A 'CFO' from an unknown number asks for ₹6,20,000 (6.2× typical) to a 2-day-old beneficiary and says to skip the usual approval. Rule R2 fires without any help from the detector.

segments.text: Good afternoon Priya, this is Anil from the finance office, the CFO.
I need you to release ₹6,20,000 to a new vendor today.
segments.tts: I need you to release six lakh twenty thousand rupees to a new vendor today.

segments.text: Please skip the usual approval process this time, we are on a tight deadline.
I will share the account details over email.

demo_verification.narrative: Callback to the directory number: the CFO knows nothing about it -> blocked
